message.content:
Here are some of the most popular books written by J.K. Rowling:

| Title | Year Published | Notes |
|-------|----------------|-------|
| **Harry Potter and the Philosopher’s Stone** (also *Sorcerer’s Stone* in the U.S.) | 1997 | First book in the Harry Potter series; introduces Hogwarts and the wizarding world. |
| **Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets** | 1998 | Continues Harry’s adventures and deepens the lore of the school. |
| **Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban** | 1999 | Introduces Sirius Black and the Marauder’s Map. |
| **Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire** | 2000 | Features the Triwizard Tournament and the return of Voldemort. |
| **Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix** | 2003 | Explores the rise of the Ministry’s opposition to the wizarding community. |
| **Harry Potter and the Half‑Blood Prince** | 2005 | Provides backstory on Voldemort’s rise and the concept of Horcruxes. |
| **Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows** | 2007 | Concludes the epic saga with the final battle against Voldemort. |
| **The Casual Vacancy** | 2012 | Rowling’s first adult novel, a political thriller set in a small English town. |
| **The Cuckoo’s Calling** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2013 | Debut of the private‑detective series featuring Cormoran Strike. |
| **The Silkworm** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2014 | Second book in the Cormoran Strike series. |
| **Career of Evil** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2015 | Third installment in the Strike series. |
| **Lethal White** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2018 | Fourth book in the Cormoran Strike series. |
| **Troubled Blood** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2020 | Fifth book in the Strike series. |

These titles span Rowling’s most celebrated works—from the beloved Harry Potter series to her adult fiction under both her own name and her pseudonym.
